title: Nice idea, but not worth $40 a month
text: I don’t have anything totally negative to say about the box except for the price. It offers activities that can be completed in an hour and then “date night” is over. For $40, there are many other activities you can experience with your significant other.  If the box was $20, it would be worth it! I say try it and see what you think, but for me, It’s not worth what the company wants me to pay for it!
label: neutral
